description.en:
* Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. By default, this feature is disabled.  
* true: Enable; false: Disable.

description.zh:
* 是否输出原图坐标信息（如果图片被做过旋转，图片校正等处理），默认不需要。
* 如需输出原图坐标，建议同时将NeedRotate参数设置为true。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to output original image coordinate information (for example, if the image has undergone rotation or correction). By default, this feature is disabled.  
* If you need original coordinates, we recommend setting the NeedRotate parameter to true.  
* true: Enable; false: Disable.

description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 encoding is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云精细版结构化切题，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于整页练习册、试卷或教辅种的题目场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |智能识别|自动切题，并识别其中的全部字段和坐标位置。| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [教育场景识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=paper_structured#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[精细版结构化切题资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0978%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduPaperStructed?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • URL长度不能超过2048。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud's Fine-grained Structured Question Extraction is an OCR product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud, designed for scenarios involving entire pages of exercise books, exam papers, or educational supplementary materials. * Powered by DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and vast datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over years to deliver stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Intelligent Detection | Automatically segments questions and detects all fields along with their coordinate positions. | | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Broad Coverage Across Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or have arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Education Scenario Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the feature free of charge via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=paper_structured#intro). | | 2 | Purchase the [Fine-grained Structured Question Extraction Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0978%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduPaperStructed?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to retrieve the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, it is recommended that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small may reduce recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image File Size |
  • The binary file size must not exceed 10 MB.
  • The URL length must not exceed 2048 characters.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
  • Images that are too small may reduce recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Other Notes |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, though this may affect accuracy. Please use images with high definition, minimal glare, and no distortion whenever possible.
|
